fieldValues.title: Essay citations had drifted outside the essay's references container
fieldValues.summary: Nine records that evidence or counter a paragraph of Rebuilding Small Democracy were not in its references container, and four of them were in no container at all, so a slice of the essay would have cut those citations.
evidence: muSrs main at 77bfd0be: evidences/counters relations into the essay container's paragraphs, sources not in container bc6397bc
fieldValues.body: Likely cause: the references container is maintained by the essay editor's snapshot, and citations added by agents or other tools bypass it. Fixed in the branch above. A check that every evidences/counters source of an essay paragraph is in that essay's references container would keep it true.
